subject: Retro billing adjustments on AWS Marketplace invoice — entity routing and VAT
messages:
From: Sofia Almeida <billing@orion-analytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Mercer <tom.mercer@orion-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Unexpected retrocharge on Feb AWS Marketplace invoice (invoice OR-2028-02)

Hi Hannah / Marcus,

We were reconciling our February payouts and noticed a retroactive adjustment ("retrocharge") on invoice OR-2028-02 that appears to have been routed to Redwood's US entity. Our accounting shows that the listing associated with our contract should route to the Redwood EU entity, which affects VAT treatment. The adjustment amount is EUR 12,430.32 and on our side it triggered VAT corrections we didn't expect.

Can you confirm:
- Which Redwood entity was used for the original charge and the retro adjustment?
- Whether you can request a seller-side credit note or reissued invoice routing to the EU entity so we can reclaim/offset VAT correctly?

I've attached the invoice and a brief payments export (ORION_202802-Marketplace-Invoice.pdf). Please let me know what evidence you need from us to expedite a fix with Marketplace.

We'd like to resolve this before our month-end close (Mar 20). Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sofia Almeida
Head of Finance
Orion Analytics
--
Attachment: ORION_202802-Marketplace-Invoice.pdf (application/pdf, 412KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Almeida <billing@orion-analytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Unexpected retrocharge on Feb AWS Marketplace invoice (invoice OR-2028-02)

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear note and the file.

Short answers up front: we see the same adjustment in our settlement logs and it looks like the retro was processed against the US seller-entity on the marketplace side. That's why you're seeing the US routing / VAT mismatch. We will initiate a request with the marketplace to reassign the retro to our EU entity and to issue a corrective credit note.

Immediate next steps I propose (mutual action plan):
1) We (Redwood) will open a support case with Marketplace ops and request a reallocation + credit note. Target ETA: 7 business days after case open.
2) Orion to confirm the EU billing/legal entity you expect the charges to land on and provide any VAT registration docs for your entity (if not already provided).
3) We will share Redwood's VAT evidence and our marketplace listing metadata to help speed adjudication.
4) Schedule a 30-minute triage call (see proposed times below).

I've attached a zip of our standard VAT evidence and listing snapshot for the Orion listing (redwood_vat_evidence_for_orion.zip). Marcus — looping you and Lauren in on the case because Lauren's team will need to approve the credit once Marketplace issues it.

Proposed call windows (ET):
- Mon Mar 13, 09:00–10:00 or 16:00–17:00
- Tue Mar 14, 11:00–12:00

If you can confirm a slot and also the exact legal entity name (and VAT number) that should be used, we'll proceed with the Marketplace case.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0128
--
Attachment: redwood_vat_evidence_for_orion.zip (application/zip, 220KB)

Subject: Re: Unexpected retrocharge on Feb AWS Marketplace invoice (invoice OR-2028-02)

Hi Sofia — following up after internal triage. Thanks for confirming the legal entity: "Orion Analytics Limited, VAT GB123456789" and for sending the CSV with marketplace order ids (received earlier today).

Summary / agreed actions: 
- Redwood will open a Marketplace ops case today (ticket #RD-MP-20280315-77) requesting: (a) reallocation of the retro charge (MP-RETR-94231) to Redwood EU entity, (b) issuance of a seller-side credit note routing the EUR 12,430.32 to Orion with the corrected VAT line.
- Orion will provide any additional PO references if they must appear on the credit note (by EOD Mar 16).
- Lauren's finance team will validate the marketplace credit when issued and confirm with Orion. Lauren — please confirm once the credit is visible in our settlements console so I can close the case on your approval.

If Marketplace responds with questions we'll loop in Tom from Orion (cc'd) on the case thread. I'll follow up with the Marketplace ticket link and expected SLA — aiming for resolution within 7 business days but will flag if Marketplace requires more time.

Proposed call: Tue Mar 14, 11:00 ET didn't work for Orion; we instead booked Thu Mar 16 at 09:30 ET — invite to follow.

Thanks again — will update as soon as we have the marketplace ticket number and any supporting docs from them.

Best,
Hannah
Director, Revenue Operations
